mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate directly increases the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to lower expected S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the core CPI index exceeds 305.0, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening and reduces corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL > 305.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and high housing starts (HOUST > 1350.0) signals an overheating economy that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when both UNRATE < 4.0 and HOUST > 1350.0.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a declining unemployment rate signals labor market tightness that precedes Fed tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months during late-cycle expansions when UNRATE is declining.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth, as measured by rising nonfarm payrolls, indicates robust consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (relative to 2017=100) signals an imminent economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: When core inflation exceeds 305.0 and the federal funds rate remains below 5.0%, it signals a delayed monetary policy response to inflation, causing market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL > 305.0 and FEDFUNDS <= 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of real GDP (above 22000 billion dollars) indicates a strong economy with robust corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters when GDPC1 > 22000.
